d:
Artist link: https://www.furaffinity.net/user/catnapcaddy/
Originally posted December 3, 2025

original posts included a corespondent story:

Week 1

Hey diary! Angus here, and I've got some GREAT news.

I got a new job! Yeah! I was driving out in the country on an errand and came on this farm with a now hiring sign. Now I'm from the country myself and y'all know I moved out to the big city a fair few years back, but I always loved that kinda life, things seemed a lot simpler back then yknow?

So on a whim I went to check and even the sign said enjoy a new life! How bout that huh? I talked to the owner, SUPER sweet lady who just needed some help with the physical labor.

So I thought why not? Room and board are provided, the pay seems good and something about free milk? Well I'm not one to look a gift horse in the mouth so I took it! I even start next week, how's that for fast?

This is so exciting!

Week 2

Hey diary! It's been a busy week I'll tell you what.

They got me to working right away. They introduced me to other people on the farm and ill tell ya, dressing up for fun is one thing but they seem pretty serious about that.

This week was mainly tending the fields, my supervisor seems to like horses and god damn he's as strong as a stallion so I'll give him that.

It's been real tough and I don't really think I'm doing that good, everyone says I'll grow into it and I guess they were right! I didnt know muscle could build so fast? But I'm getting swelling on my body all over, my pecs are huge!

Can't wait to tell ya about next week!

Week 3

Hey, diary, soooo I don't think it's just muscle that's building, and those DEFINITELY aren't pecs I'm getting, no sir. Along with what I'm reckoning is a tail and horns, I don't think this farm is just cosplay for fun. Weird thing is, the main thing keeping me a man is still right on where it usually is, and not to jump the gun here, but I think it's bigger as well? Ain't that something!

The thing is though, I can't exactly muster up the motivation to be more bothered about this. I mean, I definitely should be more worried right? But I'll tell you what, it feels....pretty good? Keep that under your hat ok, diary?

I'll see how it shakes out, in the meantime, I gotta get ready for work

Week 4

Howdy, diary! I don't know if it's the air or what but I keep on yakking with a bit of that folksy charm!

I decided in the end I was gonna keep at it, I'm just having too much darn fun! It's hard work but everyone's so friendly and love hanging around while I work! Some seem a little TOO keen sometimes, but the more the merrier! The work's good distraction too, my mood's getting kinda....well shucks don't worry about it.

Only problem I'm having is I keep tearing through clothes so dang fast, only thing that really still sorta works is my old trusty shirt. I'm really packing on the pounds! Growing into a darn strong bovine, I'll tell you what!

I'll keep ya posted, diary!

Week 5

So, diary, remember when I was talking about mood? I reckon I figured out what it is.

Pardon the joke what with my new head ornaments, but I'm just too darn horny all the time! I can barely keep it together half the time! I don't even know how I'm managing to write in you, can't really think straight at night with nothing to do....

I've been keeping it to myself, but I'm gonna have to holler I think....

Week ??

Howdy dairy, whoops, I mean diary! Lil' joke for you there

I'm awful sorry I ain't written in you in so long, so I'll just give you a heck of an update! So I did end up hollering at the owner, and she seemed mighty sorry she didn't mention it sooner, but as part of my uh, "training", I was gonna start feeling some mighty strong urges. They were gonna have me as a farmhand and dairy cow, but apparently their bull retired and they wanted me to step in, which I'm reckoning is why I kept little Angus here, or I reckon not so little now, huh! I get to keep half the farm "entertained", and I'll tell ya something, I've had worse jobs! Heh heh!

I'm pleased as punch to be here though I tell you what! Every day is fulfilling in the best way. Owner said I'm so good with folks she wants me to take over recruitment, find some new fillies and what not.

If you ever find the farm, gimme a holler! I'll set ya right

- Angus
